title: Kling 4.0 adds 30-second clips, stereo sound, and up to 10 keyframes
friendlyTitle: Kling 4.0 can make a 30-second clip with stereo sound
summary: Kling AI says version 4.0 became available to everyone on 15 October. A clip can run from 3 to 30 seconds, at 720p, 1080p, or 4K, with two-channel stereo and up to 10 keyframe images. Prompts can run to 8,000 tokens. Reference input can include up to 10 images, 5 videos totalling 30 seconds, and 7 elements, within a cap of 15 items. Lip sync and on-screen text cover Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Hindi, and more. A Flash variant is aimed at faster generation. Kling says 4.0 is also available through MCP and a command-line tool, so an agent can call it.
friendlySummary: Kling AI says version 4.0 opened to everyone on 15 October. A clip can last from 3 to 30 seconds, at 720p, 1080p, or 4K, with stereo sound and up to 10 keyframe images. A prompt can be up to 8,000 tokens. You can also attach up to 10 images, 5 short videos, and 7 other elements, within a limit of 15 items. Lip sync and on-screen text cover Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Hindi, and more. A faster Flash version is included. Kling says an agent can call 4.0 through MCP or a command line.
whyItMatters: For someone making short product or story clips, the useful change is control: more than one keyframe, a longer single pass, and sound in the same generation. API pricing is not in the release note. Treat the quality claims as the company's until you run your own clip.
